conflicts.description: Sandberg's independence after she left employment (2022-10-01). The 2023 proxy's general sentence says every current non-employee director is independent, which read literally includes her. The same proxy counts 'Seven out of our nine director nominees' as independent, which leaves out Zuckerberg and Sandberg. It heads her bio 'Director' where others read 'Independent Director', and the nominee table gives her no independence mark. Recorded as non_independent_director, medium confidence.

Powell McCormick's title 'President and Vice Chairman' (from 2026-01-12) is an officer title, not a board vice-chair seat. She resigned from the board on 2025-12-19. The 8-K says she served on the Board 'from April 2025 until December 2025'. Her 2026 Form 3 is filed as an officer (isDirector 0), and she was not a 2026 nominee. No vice_chair role is recorded.

White, Elkann and Songhurst were announced on 2025-01-06 (8-K filing date and press release) but took their seats on 2024-12-30, the 8-K effective date. Their Form 3 event dates and the proxies ('Director Since: 2024') agree. Start recorded as 2024-12-30.

Board-size bookkeeping has gaps. No filing states the increases from 7 to 11 when Houston, Killefer, Travis and Kimmitt joined in Feb-Mar 2020, or the cut from 11 to 9 at the 2020 meeting. Nor does any filing state the 9 -> 11 increase for Arnold and Tan (2024-02-13), or the 15 -> 14 change after Powell McCormick resigned (the 2026 proxy simply says the current authorized number is fourteen). Only disclosed changes are BOARD_SIZE_CHANGE events. The 2024-12-30 from_size of 10 is the size set at the 2024 annual meeting.

Kimmitt's Lead Independent Director start day. The 8-K (filed 2020-03-26, his seat's effective date) says the independent directors 'have appointed' him but gives no separate effective date, and the 2020 proxy says 'since March 2020'. Recorded as 2020-03-26, since he could not hold the role before his seat took effect and the 8-K reports it as done on that day.

open_questions: Pre-IPO start dates are disclosed only to the month: Zuckerberg (July 2004), Thiel (April 2005) and Andreessen (June 2008). No filing gives a day.
Independence spans for pre-IPO directors (Andreessen, Thiel) begin at their board start by convention. The first disclosed determination is the 2012 IPO prospectus.
The exact day Sandberg stopped being COO is not stated. Olivan became COO effective 2022-08-01, and Sandberg stayed an employee through 2022-09-30. The executive_director span runs to 2022-09-30.

Committee rosters are captured only at proxy snapshots: the 2026 proxy (as of the 2026-05-27 meeting) and the last proxy for each departed director. Changes between filings are not dated. Examples: the June 2025 restructuring assignments, Alford's and Arnold's Audit & Privacy appointments ('effective as of May 2026', no day), and Travis moving from Audit & Risk Oversight chair to Audit & Privacy member.
Kimmitt, Collison and Zuckerberg sit on no standing committee per the 2026 proxy. Kimmitt was on the Privacy & Product Compliance Committee in the 2025 proxy.
Other-board lists come from Meta's own bios and are not checked against other issuers' filings. Chenault's former IBM/P&G boards come from a narrative bio that does not say the companies are public.
Peggy Alford became eBay CFO in 2025 (2026 proxy). No independence change was disclosed, and the 2026 proxy still lists her as independent.

coverage.method: Roster taken from the 2026 DEF 14A (twelve nominees, all elected 2026-05-27 per the 8-K Item 5.07). No 8-K with Item 5.02 was filed after the proxy through 2026-09-30, the latest filing in the EDGAR submissions feed. Every Form 3 and Form 4 filed in 2026 was checked: all twelve directors filed as directors, and no new director Form 3 appeared.

Reviewed every DEF 14A from 2019 to 2026 (plus the 2020 supplement), every 8-K or 8-K/A with Item 5.02 or 5.07 filed 2019-2026, and every Form 3 since 2012. Nominee lists were reconciled across consecutive proxies, and departures were dated from 8-K effective dates or Item 5.07 annual-meeting dates.

Only start dates of directors who served on or after 2020-01-01, taken from the IPO prospectus, proxy bios and appointment 8-Ks. Departures before 2020 (e.g. Desmond-Hellmann 2019-10-30, Bowles and Hastings 2019-05-30, Koum 2018) are out of scope and not recorded.
